title: Children's Out-of-Network Frame Amount — Cascade Vision Glasses Claims
content:
On a Vision Plans out-of-network claim settled on its glasses part, the frame amount follows the plan and the patient:

1. **Plan with no frame benefit:** nothing (0.00).
2. **Patient under 19 on the date of service:** the children's out-of-network frame amount, **90.00**.
3. **Everyone else:** the plan's out-of-network frame amount.

The patient's age is counted in whole years from the enrollee's date of birth to the date of service; 19 is the child age limit.

| Plan | Frame benefit | Patient under 19 | Patient 19 or over |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Vision Exam Plus | No | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Vision Essential 100 | Yes | 90.00 | 50.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 130 | Yes | 90.00 | 65.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 150 | Yes | 90.00 | 70.00 |
| Cascade Vision Choice 175 | Yes | 90.00 | 80.00 |
| Cascade Vision Premier 200 | Yes | 90.00 | 100.00 |

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** For a patient born on 27 October, a frame dated 26 October of the 19th birthday year has a frame amount of 90.00. A frame dated 27 October has the plan's adult figure, for example 65.00 on Cascade Vision Select 130.
